summary.en: Kelun-Biotech, Kelun Pharmaceutical's innovative-drug subsidiary, concentrates on oncology ADCs and external development collaborations. Respiratory immunology provides a smaller diversification stream.
summary.zh: Kelun-Biotech 是 Kelun Pharmaceutical 的创新药子公司,专注于肿瘤 ADC 和对外开发合作。呼吸免疫领域提供规模较小的多元化方向。

ind.en: First-line NSCLC and TNBC; additional global cancer studies
ind.zh: 一线 NSCLC 和 TNBC;另有全球其他癌症研究

next.zh: 潜在商业化,以获批为前提

watch.en: MSD is running 17 global Phase 3 sac-TMT studies.
watch.zh: MSD 正在开展 17 项全球 III 期 sac-TMT 研究。

watch.en: Three commercial products have indications included in China's NRDL.
watch.zh: 三款商业化产品的适应症已纳入中国国家医保药品目录 (NRDL)。

watch.en: July 2026 share placing raised approximately HK$2.72 billion net.
watch.zh: 2026 年 7 月的股份配售净筹集约 HK$2.72 billion。

watch.en: The portfolio emphasizes ADCs and combination oncology therapies.
watch.zh: 该组合以 ADC 和肿瘤联合疗法为重点。
